text:
Clare: Quick flag - the metering page still says 'requests billed at plan rate' which is causing confusion in support. billing is token-level now and the docs should say that clearly.
Devon: can you paste the sentence? i can propose alternate wording.
Clare: current: "Requests are billed at the plan rate associated with the API key used."
Proposed replacement: "Billing is calculated per token. Tokens are attributed to a tier based on the API key by default; an optional override header can attribute tokens to a different tier for a request or part of a session."
analytics-bot: NOTE: attribution is emitted per-token as a tag named `tier` in the usage stream. dashboards aggregate that tag by window.
Luis: add a compact example so readers see why a single billing window can have multiple tier rows. e.g.:
```
Billing window: 2026-10-01
API key tier (default): standard -> 1,400 tokens
Requests with header X-Redwood-Client-Tier: enterprise -> 350 tokens
Result: 1,400 tokens billed at standard rate, 350 tokens billed at enterprise rate (attributed per-token).
```
Clare: good — i'll avoid the word "overage" to prevent implying thresholds. also include migration note: old header `X-Plan` -> new `X-Redwood-Client-Tier` (v2).
Devon: please also add a one-line clarification about rate-limit fallbacks: if a request is routed to a fallback model variant, billing attribution does not change unless the api-key or override header differs. saves loads of tickets.
Clare: adding small SDK snippets for curl / python / node. draft curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client-Tier: enterprise" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the meeting"}'
```
python snippet: 
```
import requests
headers = {
  "Authorization": f"Bearer {KEY}",
  "X-Redwood-Client-Tier": "enterprise"  # optional override for this request
}
requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/completions', json={"prompt":"Summarize"}, headers=headers)
```
node snippet: 
```
await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v1/completions', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}`, 'X-Redwood-Client-Tier': 'enterprise' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Summarize' })
})
```
Clare: i'll add a short dashboard caption note: "Panel breaks down token usage by attribution tag: default vs override. If you see multiple rows, it's token-level attribution, not multiple billing windows."
docs-ci: link-check: 1 broken link found in docs/metering.md: /billing/tiers -> suggested /pricing/tiers
Clare: will fix the link and add a docs-test asserting /pricing/tiers resolves. opening PR in a few mins and tagging @Devon @Luis for review.
Devon: tiny editorial nit: replace "enterprise rate" with "enterprise tier rate" in the example to avoid implying discounts vs tier names. otherwise LGTM.
Clare: done. PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1129 — includes copy tweaks, snippets, migration note, dashboard caption, linkfix, and test. ping for reviews.
Luis: will review this afternoon, thanks.
Clare: merging after CI. :rocket:
